item.title: Trust
item.description:
Trust Janaka Stagnaro

Source: TW

Author: Janaka Stagnaro

Purchase Janaka’s book ‘Footprints Along the Shore of an Incoming Tide ’

Link to Janaka’s website.

The following is an extract from the above book:

The river has swept me into the wilds of Hollywood, where people puff on large egos. What a strange land where who you know comes before who you are. Everyone hustling, everyone looking for the big break, hopeful with every encounter and promise; while all the time being distrustful, seeing knives held behind backs. Money here is like thoughts of a crazy, whirling mind, swirling around in bunches, in figures more suited for governments, coming from all directions; quickly here, quickly gone. Limos and body guards, silicon implants and plastic smiles. It’s hard to have trust in such a place. It takes one brave or one foolish to wade waters full of crocodiles.
